evidence.quote: I see it as appropriate to begin gradually moving our moderately restrictive policy stance toward a neutral setting.
My Summary of Economic Projections includes three cuts for this year, which has been consistent with my forecast since last December, and the latest labor market data reinforce my view.
The underlying trend in core PCE inflation appears to be moving much closer to our 2 percent target than is currently shown in the data.
I see that upside risks to price stability have diminished.
Payroll employment growth slowed sharply to only 35,000 jobs per month over the three months ending in July.
I see the risk that a delay in taking action could result in a deterioration in labor market conditions and a further slowing in economic growth.

parsed.rationale: The speaker explains her dissent in favor of a rate cut and advocates moving policy toward neutral, with three cuts this year. She frames tariff inflation as transitory and emphasizes downside labor market risks; the remainder of the speech covers community bank regulation, which is why relevance is medium.
